identifiers.name: PRM / PDL
identifiers.description: The 14-digit identifier of a metering point of the French distribution grid (point de référence mesure, also point de livraison), issued by the distribution operator of the connection.

identifiers.name: Code INSEE
identifiers.description: The code of a municipality in the official geographic code of the statistics office (code commune INSEE): the level at which the distribution operator, planning rules and most datasets are decided. It is not the postal code.

identifiers.name: BAN address
identifiers.description: The identifier of an address in the Base Adresse Nationale: municipality code, street, number.

identifiers.name: SIREN
identifiers.description: The 9-digit identifier of a company in the national register.

identifiers.name: SIRET
identifiers.description: The 14-digit identifier of an establishment: the SIREN of its company and a 5-digit number.

identifiers.name: Cadastral parcel
identifiers.description: The 14-character identifier of a cadastral parcel: municipality (5), prefix (3), section (2), number (4).

identifiers.name: RNB building
identifiers.description: The 12-character identifier of a building in the Référentiel National des Bâtiments.
